skills.name: memory-architecture
skills.description: Keeps coding-agent memory cheap and true, so Claude stops forgetting between sessions, re-reading bloated CLAUDE.md files, redoing research and acting on stale notes. Knows which files actually load and when (CLAUDE.md at every level, AGENTS.md, .claude/rules, MEMORY.md), where each fact belongs, and the gates that stop it rotting. Ships a self-testing audit script and a 0-10 score. Use it for any question about those files, even a narrow one, before answering from memory or searching by hand. That includes which CLAUDE.md files load in a folder, whether the paths an AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md mentions still exist, why an agent ignored or broke a rule it was given, how to make Claude Code, Cursor and Codex follow the same rules, how to set up, audit, slim down or clean up agent memory, where a rule or fact should live, and why an agent keeps forgetting, redoing work or burning tokens. Also use it before saving a memory or writing an agent-facing doc, even if nobody says "memory".
